entities.name: Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar
entities.description: Small, slender female wizard and great cook from Dominaria who wrote the Underworld Cookbook.

entities.name: Vincent
entities.description: Lord of the Pit Asmor summoned for a duel and cooked for.

entities.name: Underworld Cookbook
entities.description: Cookbook of Asmor's recipes that became all the rage in the overworld.

entities.name: Hell
entities.description: Where Vincent kept Asmor as chef.

events.summary: Asmor summons the Lord of the Pit Vincent for a duel, runs out of food to feed it, and escapes being eaten by becoming his chef for seven years and seven days.
events.quote: She escaped being eaten herself by entering into his service as a chef

events.summary: Vincent asks her to collect her recipes; about twenty cookbook copies are made and only two sold.
events.quote: only two were sold in five months

events.summary: Asmor orders the remaining books burned but the imps toss them to the overworld, where the recipes become the rage and the hunted creatures grow a grudge against her.
events.quote: they ended up being all the rage in the high courts

events.summary: Asmor decides to write a second volume to get the monsters off her back.
events.quote: She decided to write a second volume to the cookbook

relations.note: his chef for seven years and seven days
relations.quote: entering into his service as a chef for seven years and seven days
About 20 copies of the Underworld Cookbook were made
